section: Jesus Drives Out an Impure Spirit / Jesus Heals Many

heading.en: Authority no one had ever seen

body.en: Jesus went into the synagogue at Capernaum and began to teach — and the people were amazed, because He taught with AUTHORITY, not like the teachers of the law. Suddenly, a man with an impure spirit cried out, and Jesus commanded: 'Be quiet! Come out of him!' The spirit shook the man violently and came out with a shriek. The people were astonished — news about Jesus spread quickly through the whole region of Galilee! Then Jesus went to Simon's house, where Simon's mother-in-law was in bed with a fever. Jesus took her by the hand and helped her up — the fever left her immediately, and she got up and began to serve them! That evening, after sunset, the whole town gathered at the door, bringing the sick and demon-possessed. Jesus healed many who had various diseases and drove out many demons. One ordinary day in Capernaum, and the whole town had seen, up close, exactly who Jesus was.

verse.en: The people were amazed at his teaching, because he taught them as one who had authority.

label.en: Activity sheet: A Day Full of Miracles

body.en:
Big idea: Jesus' authority is demonstrated, not just claimed — over teaching, over evil spirits, over sickness, all within a single busy day. Mark moves rapidly through these scenes to build a cumulative impression: this is no ordinary teacher.

Conversation starters: (1) What's the difference between authority and just being loud or confident? (2) Why might Simon's mother-in-law's immediate response be to serve, right after being healed? (3) What does it show about Jesus that He kept healing late into the evening, even after a full day?

Pray, thanking Jesus for His authority over every kind of need.
